For Nasa, it feels like destiny is finally calling out to him that he will have a girlfriend, but things take a turn for the worse when Nasa is hit by a car and unable to attend his entrance exams. A year later Nasa aces the entrance exams, but he decides to work a part time job and live by himself instead of going to school.
